title: Hook (spoken): Here are the next 7 days...
prompt:
Hook (spoken): Here are the next 7 days of sales, before you place the order.
Hook (on-screen): Next 7 days. Before you order.
Main copy:
Here are the next 7 days of sales, before you place the order. Yukti's sales and demand forecast
shows your past sales next to the expected sales for the coming days, with a likely range. Each
forecast has a reliability score, and the model is backtested against your past sales before the
forecast shows. Know what's coming, then order.
CTA: See your own 7-day forecast on the free trial. Link in bio.
Why it works: Forecast charts are naturally visual. The payoff is the line going forward into dashed
"future estimate," and the reliability badge answers the first question people ask: can I trust this? The
caption says "backtested," which matches what the screen says.
Screen to record: Sales & Demand Forecasts. Pause on the dashed future line and the reliability badge.
